content.content: An exclude file that exists but cannot be read refuses the invocation, naming the cause.
content.rationale: Absence reads as empty (S2-exclude-read-absent, zvmsnkln); a file that is there but unreadable is a different state, and reading it as empty would let the append write over lines it never saw — the clobber the interface exists to prevent. Refusing names the cause, and deleting the file recovers through missing-is-empty.
